採用・広告の製品.quote: Most advisors are great at advising — they were never taught how to market. Growing the practice is the other job: finding the right new clients, building a brand they trust, showing up consistently, knowing what’s actually working. There’s never enough time for all of it.

That’s why we built FINNY — to own that part. We get the right prospect in front of you at the right time, with the right message: a curated email, a personalized message on a topic they care about, an article worth their inbox. Then we follow up — every nudge, every touch — until they’re on your calendar.
A whole marketing team in one tool.
Surface the leads worth your time
Tell us your niche, or let FINNY help you define it. Then, get the prospects whose needs align with what you do best, surfaced in the moment money is in motion.

We learn your voice as we go. Tell us anything you want us to know. FINNY writes the personalized messages, the market updates, the articles. Original content that sounds like you, on the topics your prospects actually care about. Our AI scans news, markets, and your clients’ patterns to draft the pieces that earn attention. You stay top of mind without writing a thing.
The best prospects, sorted and ranked for you.

FINNY is the marketing team you didn’t have to hire.

Our AI agent plans campaigns from real signals: news, markets, and what your niche cares about. It generates new ones on demand, then handles every send and follow-up across the channels that matter. Approve before each campaign goes out, or let it ship. We tell you when a meeting hits the calendar. We notify you on every inbound. We keep track of what’s next so you don’t have to.
A marketing team that never clocks out.

Every prospect, every site visit, every campaign, every meeting becomes data the system learns from. Every campaign you run teaches us what worked. The next one starts smarter than the last. Your messaging improves. Your content lands. Your targeting tightens. Your timing gets better. A full team behind you, getting sharper every day.
Best AI Marketing and Lead Generation Technology

FINNY is solving the biggest challenge advisors face today: finding and connecting with the right clients. Advisors are great at building relationships, but they don’t have the time — or the right tools — to consistently find new prospects.
The FINNY team is working on an innovative solution for advisors, and I’m excited to see what the future holds for this impressive team.
FINNY AI’s approach to prospecting illustrates how technology can support authentic human connections. Rather than encouraging mass outreach, their platform prioritizes quality over quantity.

FINNY maintains an ongoing SOC 2 Type 2 examination program. Our controls are examined by an independent CPA firm on a continuous basis, with no gaps between observation periods. The current report is available to prospective and current clients on request.

FINNY is priced to reflect the value that it brings to your firm. Get access to an entire sales and marketing platform for a low subscription fee. Beyond that, you pay as you grow, and only for as long as each client stays. We win when you win.

Common questions about FINNY Pricing

FINNY's basic pricing is $50 per month, plus 20bps on AUM from FINNY-sourced new clients. We charge on new assets FINNY helped you bring in, not on your entire book. Enterprise and larger firms can contact sales@finny.com for additional pricing options.

The assets of new clients FINNY is attributed with helping you win. Not your whole book, and not your existing clients. FINNY sourcing is tied to outreach activity - simply surfacing a name in a prospect list does not count as sourcing.

Not charged. Net-new assets from existing clients prior to joining FINNY are not captured by our system: the pricing model is only applied to net-new accounts that were funded. If FINNY's data uncovers more assets on someone who was already your client, we will not bill on that.

In scope: asset-based advisory fees only. Out of scope: commissions, flat fees, insurance products, and annuities; FINNY does not charge on any of those. If a client is partly commission-based or advice-only, we charge only on the asset-based advisory portion; the commission or advice-only portion is not billable.

FINNY isn't just another cold outreach engine. Our data model finds the best prospects, for the advisors best equipped to close.
Choosing an advisor is deeply personal. FINNY helps you break the ice and build trust with your prospects.

Eden is originally from Montreal, where she received a Software Engineering degree from McGill University, specializing in Machine Learning. While at McGill, she worked at EY and KPMG as a Cyber Security Advisory Associate. Upon graduation, Eden joined BCG NYC, where she primarily worked in the Tech, Financial Institutions & Private Equity practices for over 2 years.
President & Co-founder

Victoria grew up in Greece, and came to the United States to attend Stanford, where she studied Symbolic Systems with a focus in Artificial intelligence. Prior to starting FINNY, Victoria was a Product Manager at Uber, leading membership growth for Uber One. Victoria is also a Kleiner Perkins Fellow and a published author, on Greece's contribution to Math.

Theo holds a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence from Ecole Polytechnique, Paris, and a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and Math from McGill University. During his studies, Theo held research roles in high-energy physics and explainable Machine Learning. Prior to starting FINNY, he worked as a machine learning engineer at an early Fintech startup.

Three AI engineers founded FINNY in 2024 to solve the most painful problem in wealth management: organic growth. In just two years, we’ve become an industry leader: raising over $20M from Y Combinator, Venrock, and some of the biggest names in wealth management, with backing from Josh Brown (Ritholtz), Jason Wenk (Altruist), and Bill McNabb.

We’ve been named Morningstar’s Fintech Showcase winner, Datos Insights’ Best WealthTech Company 2025, the 2025 Wealthies’ Best Marketing Automation Platform, and were selected to present at Future Proof. Our founders were named to Forbes 30 Under 30 in AI.

What kind of revenue is the fee based on?

When the client leaves. The fee is tied to the living client relationship, not a term of years, so we do not cap it at a fixed number of years. It is billed quarterly in arrears on a quarter-end snapshot, so in a down market the fee falls with you.

The $50 seat fee is monthly. The 20 bps fee is billed quarterly in arrears: a snapshot of the assets in the attributed account on the last business day of the quarter, billed at 5 bps for that quarter (the 20 bps annual rate divided by four). Billing only starts after your paid signup is completed and your account is activated.
